label: Press Release
title: Cognera Health Appoints Advisor Board
summary: Cognera Health announces new advisor appointments to support product innovation and business development.
paragraphs: Cognera Health Inc., a category-defining leader in CogneraAI™ powered care technology delivering continuous, evidence-based, and integrated care through cognitive and collaborative intelligence™, is pleased to announce the appointment of Dr. Patrick K. Faircloth, Ph.D., LPC-S (AL), LPC (MI), NCC and Dr. Paul F. Hard, Ph.D., LPC-S (AL), NCC to its Board of Directors as Product and Business Development Advisors.
In addition, Dr. Chris DaSambiagio-Moore, Ph.D., LPC-S, joins Cognera Health as a Product Innovation and Business Development Advisor.

Dr. Patrick Faircloth brings over 30 years of clinical experience and more than 20 years as a counselor educator. He has dedicated his career to advancing therapeutic healthcare practices and previously served as Associate Professor and Associate Chair of a Counseling Department. He currently serves as a full-time faculty member in the Department of Counseling, Educational Leadership & Higher Education at Central Michigan University.

Dr. Paul Hard contributes over 30 years of clinical counseling experience and more than 25 years as a counselor educator. A recognized leader in the field, he serves as Department Chair for Counseling, Leadership, and Special Education at Auburn University at Montgomery, where he continues to shape the next generation of counselors and educators.

Dr. Chris Dasambiagio-Moore is a Licensed Professional Counselor-Supervisor, counseling professor, and Jungian psychoanalytic candidate with over a decade of experience across mental health, behavioral health, wellness, addictions, career counseling, and private practice. He has held leadership roles as Program Director and Coordinator of Clinical Instruction for a mental and behavioral health counseling program and served as Past President of the Alabama Counseling Association. His work spans clinical practice and research, with a focus on the psychological dimensions of video games, the intersection of mental health and career development, and collegiate behavioral health.

Together, Dr. Faircloth, Dr. Hard, and Dr. Dasambiagio-Moore bring decades of combined expertise across clinical care, education, and leadership in mental health, behavioral health, wellness, and wellbeing. Their insights will play a critical role in advancing Cognera Health’s product innovation, business development strategy, and mission to transform care delivery.

“We are honored to welcome Dr. Patrick Faircloth and Dr. Paul Hard to our Board of Directors, and Dr. Chris DaSambiagio-Moore as a Product Innovation and Business Development Advisor,” said John Budala, Co-Founder, President & CEO of Cognera Health Inc. “Their deep expertise and leadership will accelerate our vision of delivering continuous, connected, and data-driven care through innovation and collaboration.”
Please join us in welcoming Dr. Faircloth, Dr. Hard, and Dr. Dasambiagio-Moore to the Cognera Health team.

label: Press Release
title: Cognera Health Wins Alabama Launchpad Competition
summary: Cognera Health, Inc. has been awarded $100,000 through the Alabama Launchpad Life Sciences Track.
paragraphs: Exciting News! Cognera Health, Inc. has been awarded $100,000 through the Alabama Launchpad Life Sciences Track—an important milestone that validates our mission to transform mental and behavioral healthcare through continuous, AI-powered care beyond traditional sessions.
This funding will accelerate platform development and expand our ability to deliver connected, data-driven care across Alabama communities, including underserved and rural populations.

We are deeply grateful to our advisors — Saksham Narang, Matthew Jaeh, and Cecil Bostany, Keith Cromwell, Gayle Rogers and Ryan Robinett —for their invaluable guidance and support throughout the program.
Special Thanks to Alabama Launchpad for believing in our vision and supporting innovation in healthcare.

label: Press Release
title: Cognera Health Launches Revolutionary CogneraAI™ Platform
summary: Cognera Health launches its CogneraAI™ powered platform delivering continuous, evidence-based care for clinicians, multidisciplinary care teams, and healthcare organizations.
features: CogneraAI™ powered unified continuous care platform launch
Clinical intelligence combined with human expertise
Continuous monitoring with improved engagement and adherence
Coordinated care across providers, teams, organizations and individuals
paragraphs: Cognera Health launches its CogneraAI™ powered platform delivering continuous, evidence-based care—designed for clinicians, multidisciplinary care teams, and healthcare organizations. The platform streamlines session workflows, automates clinical documentation, and provides real-time visibility into individual progress, enabling providers to focus on care, not administrative burden.

By integrating clinical standards, scientific research, behavioral science, and global wellbeing frameworks into a unified CogneraAI™ powered continuous care platform, Cognera bridges the gap between episodic treatment and real-world care. Built on measurement-based care and guideline-aligned decision support, the platform combines structured assessments, longitudinal tracking, and real-time analytics to enable earlier intervention, stronger clinical decisions, improved individual engagement and adherence to care plans, and better outcomes across the full continuum of care.

This launch positions Cognera Health as a category-defining care technology—advancing a vision for connected, continuous, and data-driven care Powered by CogneraAI™, enabling providers and care teams to deliver coordinated, personalized support beyond sessions.
